visual_action: Donald Trump, assisted by a soldier in dress uniform, lays a large wreath at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. A military honor guard stands in formation in the background. The scene is outdoors on a sunny day with autumn trees. The video concludes with two black and white images: one of a helicopter landing near the White House, and a final one of the White House building itself.
